title: Tangent criterion for etaleness of a finite locally free morphism
statement: Let f:X\to Y be a finite locally free morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] over a field k, and let x\in X with y=f(x) be k-rational points. Then f is etale at x if and only if the induced k-linear tangent map T_{X/k,x}\to T_{Y/k,y} is injective.

source.place: Varieties, lemma-injective-tangent-spaces-unramified (injective tangent spaces imply unramified at a rational point), together with the local-flat-unramified-etale criterion

proof.text: At the rational points x and y, the tangent map is canonically dual to the induced cotangent map on maximal ideals modulo squares [lem-sc-rational-tangent-cotangent-duality]. Linear duality identifies injectivity of the tangent map with surjectivity of the cotangent map.
By [lem-sc-rational-unramified-cotangent-criterion], surjectivity of this cotangent map is equivalent to f being unramified at x.

source.place: lemma-injective-tangent-spaces-unramified and the local unramified criterion

proof.text: By the definition of finite locally free [def-pc-finite-locally-free], f is flat and locally of finite presentation. By the definition of etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], at x the condition that f is etale is exactly flat, locally of finite presentation, and unramified. Thus, under the finite locally free hypotheses, f is etale at x if and only if it is unramified at x. Combining this with Steps 1 and 2 gives the claimed equivalence.
